cd9fa24c7b8eb7b7c810.title: Signalpost — Online, 23 Aug – 21 Oct 2026
cd9fa24c7b8eb7b7c810.summary:
23 Aug – 21 Oct 2026  · Online Organiser: Builderr Signalpost is a challenge to build an agent that finds company information online, given a Norwegian company's organisation number, searching permitted public sources and showing where each fact came from.

Entrants must submit at least 1,000 completed company profiles chosen from the supplied list, along with their agent's repository link, exact commit hash, and one command to run it. The starting list covers 411,160 eligible Norwegian companies with 2025 annual-account records, and the agent must work from a company number, including ones it has not researched before.

Entries are scored out of 100 points across coverage, accuracy, correct updating, summary usefulness and ease of use, and must also meet minimum requirements including at least 65/100 overall and 21/35 coverage, plus 60% weighted recall and 95% precision on company matching.

The main challenge offers $2,000 in prizes split $1,200, $500 and $300 for first, second and third place, plus a separate $500 JBOX bonus split $250, $150 and $100 for qualifying agents built with JBOX.  Register on the organiser's own page

01d22a68766e35af4a48.title: Barcelona AI Hackathon — Barcelona, 9–10 Oct 2026
01d22a68766e35af4a48.summary:
9–10 Oct 2026  · Barcelona · In person · Itnig Coworking Organiser: Bogdan Ponomar Three tracks. €10,000 to the team that ships the best build.
Friday evening you get the theme. Saturday afternoon you demo. Everything in between is yours.

The challenge
Coding agents have changed what four people can build in a day. This is where we find out how much.
You get the theme at kickoff. You get thirteen hours of build time across two days. You ship something that runs in a mobile browser and that a stranger can pick up and use in 60 seconds.
Any stack. Any model, any agent, any tool you want.
No pitch decks. No business models. No slides. You hand someone a phone and they use it, or they don't.

Pick your track
Ship a game. Something playable in 60 seconds. Any genre, any mechanic.
Ship a tool. Productivity. Pick a task a real person does by hand every week and build the thing that does it for them.
Ship a habit. Something for health, fitness, sleep, food — anything that makes a person do the right thing tomorrow.
Choose your track when you apply, or decide on the Friday once you've seen the theme. Each track gets its own winner.

€10,000
To the winning team. Cash.

How it's judged
Saturday afternoon, every build goes live and everyone in the room tries everything.
The €10,000 is decided by the jury — the Lytvyn.AI.Foundation , our mentors, and the organising team. Four things they're looking for:
Is it good. Is it actually finished. Is it original. And how hard did you push your agents to get there.
Every team publishes their setup afterwards: models, tools, prompting approach, total tokens burned. By Saturday night we'll know exactly what fifteen teams shipped in thirteen hours and what it cost them.

Schedule
Friday 9 October 
18:00 — Doors, food, check-in 
18:30 — Kickoff. Clock starts. 
23:00 — Venue closes. Go home, sleep on it.
Saturday 10 October 
08:00 — Doors, breakfast, back to work 
16:00 — Code freeze 
16:15 — Demos. Everyone tries everything. 
17:45 — Winners announced 
18:15 — Afterparty

Mentors on the floor, food and coffee throughout

Teams
Up to 4 people. Bring your own team, or come solo and we'll match you on the Friday.

Who this is for
Working engineers, technical founders, and anyone already building seriously with coding agents.
You don't need to have built anything like this before — most people here won't have. You need to be able to ship.

Bring
Your own laptop. Your own AI subscriptions and API keys — Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, whatever you already run on. Come with your setup working and your environment ready, so the clock goes on building instead of installing.

Included
Free entry. Food and drinks across both days. Mentors. Afterparty. A room full of people who ship.

70 places
That's the whole room, and we're keeping it that way on purpose.
Applications are reviewed — this is not a ticket. Apply below and we'll come back to you within a few days.

Venue announced shortly — central Barcelona. Powered by the Lytvyn.AI.Foundation.  Register on the organiser's own page

150 developers. One evening. Central London.
Build autonomous AI agents that handle real financial operations - agents that don't just analyse money, but move it. Ship a working prototype in three hours and demo it live to judges from Stripe, Meta, and the 10 Downing Street AI Team.
📅 Schedule
5:15 PM - Doors open & registration
5:45 PM - Opening: mission briefing, tracks and scoring explained
6:00 PM - Hacking begins. Go solo or team up (max 4 per team)

🚀 Why Join?
Ship something real - walk out with a working fintech AI agent you built in one evening

Side quests - bonus prizes for creative builds beyond the main tracks
Meet your next co-founder - 150 of London's sharpest AI and fintech builders in one room

044a3b3d18e55bbfb73c.title: Real-Time Video Agents Hack - LDN — London, 17 Oct 2026
044a3b3d18e55bbfb73c.summary:
17 Oct 2026  · London · In person · London, United Kingdom Organiser: tokens& The VAST Builders Challenge is a three-city technical event series bringing together founders and engineers across New York, London, and San Francisco to build production-ready AI systems.
Spend the day building agents to unlock the value of video. Because video is hard to search and analyze,  most of it stays in storage, unwatched and underused.
Experiment with the latest AI infrastructure, collaborate with other ambitious builders, and turn your ideas into shippable prototypes - with access to expert guidance, compute, and the tools you need to ship.
Hosted with VAST Data in collaboration with NVIDIA, SpaceXAI, CoreWeave and Weights & Biases.
Note: Registration closes on 9th October.
Prizes
1st place: NVIDIA DGX Spark™
HuggingFace Microduck
Cursor Credits
Cash Gift Cards

The Builders Stack
Here's what you get out of the box, a lightning-quick setup:
Video understanding: reason over a video clip with NVIDIA Cosmos.
Semantic search: find moments across hours of footage using natural language.
Object detection: real-time detection and tracking across frames with YOLO.
General-purpose LLMs: models from Weights & Biases to power your application logic (e.g. video agents).
The VAST AI OS orchestrates the video ingestion and data layer, models are served on CoreWeave GPUs, and builders ship with Cursor.
Build your own video agent or something no one’s thought of. We'll share the videos to get you started on building video agents.

Speaker
Brian Verkley - Director, AI Data Platform @ VAST Data
Judges
Abubakr Karali -  Senior Solutions Architect @ Nvidia
Ram B. -  Sr. Developer Advocate @ VAST Data
Brian Verkley - Director, AI Data Platform @ VAST Data
Junaid Butt -  AI Solutions Engineer @ Weights and Biases

Who should attend
Developers, ML/AI engineers, agent builders, and data engineers, from startups to enterprise teams working with video or multimodal AI.
While individuals are welcome, we encourage teams of up to four members and will prioritize team applications. You can form a team on the day of the event or arrive with one already assembled.
Applications are required. Space is limited. Registration closes one week prior to the event.
*Register with Personal Email*
We'll use this for event comms and to credit your Cursor account. Sign up for Cursor with this same personal email if you don't have an account.

Agenda
8:30am Doors Open + Breakfast 
9:00am Opening Keynotes
9:30am Build Begins
12:30pm Lunch
4:30pm  Demos
6:30pm Closing & Awards
Note: This event will be photographed and filmed. By attending, you consent to appearing in photos and videos that may be used for social media and promotional materials.

Sponsors
VAST Data: A unified AI data platform that provides the foundation for managing, processing, and activating data for AI workloads
CoreWeave: AI cloud infrastructure that delivers high-performance GPU compute for training, fine-tuning, and inference workloads.
SpaceXAI: AI-assisted software development tools that help developers move from idea to implementation faster
NVIDIA: Accelerated computing and AI software that enables developers to build and deploy advanced AI applications
Weights & Biases (A CoreWeave company): AI developer tools for experiment tracking, model evaluation, and collaborative ML development

See what’s possible.

Follow us on X · LinkedIn · Newsletter  Register on the organiser's own page

b396b35bff130b491836.title: Agentic Hackathon: From Research to Commerce — Berlin, 19 Oct 2026
b396b35bff130b491836.summary:
19 Oct 2026  · Berlin · In person · The Delta Campus Organiser: AI Agents Berlin From Research to Action: Agents That Discover, Verify & Transact

Seven hours to build an agent that actually does something. Form a team, pick a track, ship a working demo by the evening — then carry the best builds through to AIB Demo Day in December.

Monday 19 October, 14:00–21:00, at The Delta Campus, Berlin. Food and drinks throughout.

Tracks

- Research Agents: Build agents that search, retrieve, evaluate, summarise and reason over information. A fit for web research, source discovery, market intelligence, due diligence, monitoring, knowledge workflows and verified research pipelines.
- Agentic Commerce: Build agents that discover products or services, compare options, verify information and support transactions or commercial workflows. A fit for product discovery, shopping agents, marketplace automation, price comparison, procurement, MCP-based commerce workflows and agentic payments.

Agenda

- 14:00 — Doors, check-in, food
- 14:30 — Welcome, tracks and rules
- 14:45 — Partner challenges, five minutes each
- 15:10 — Team formation, solo builders paired up
- 15:45 — Build
- 18:15 — Working dinner, building continues
- 20:00 — Demos, three minutes per team
- 20:45 — Winners and what happens next
- 21:00 — Close

Partners

- Tavily — a search and retrieval API designed for powering intelligent agents with real-time, verifiable web data
- Nebius — a high-performance AI cloud platform for building and scaling modern AI systems
- Affinidi – giving every AI agent a verifiable identity
- n8n — workflow automation for agentic systems

Partner challenges, prizes and technical resources are announced on the day.

What you get

- Compute and API credits from our partners, and n8n Cloud Pro licences for participating builders.
- Mentors from the partner teams in the room while you build.
- A jury of partners and investors watching the demos.

A route to Demo Day on Dec 10: standout builders win an AIB Builder Pass, and with it a demo slot in front of the season's partner and investor bench.

Who should join

This hackathon is for:

- AI engineers and full-stack developers
- Agent builders
- Founders and product teams
- Data, search and retrieval engineers
- AI x commerce builders
- Students and researchers working on applied AI agents.

You can join solo or with a team. Builders will have the day to form teams, build, and demo their projects.

Team rules

You can join solo or with a team.

- Max. 5 people per team
- At least one team member must be onsite in Berlin
- Solo builders are welcome — we will support team formation at the beginning
- Please bring your laptop and anything else you need to build
- The event is builder-focused: please only register if you plan to actively build, mentor, judge, or support teams

Want to mentor, judge or speak?

Tell us here and we will get back to you.

Interested in sponsoring the hackathon?

Partner packages and everything else commercial start here.

About AI Agents Berlin

Berlin's community for the agentic economy. Builder sessions, hackathons, and the Agentic Economy Forum. 11,000+ community contacts and 2,000+ agent builders.

Join the builder community on Telegram to share what you are building and connect with other agent builders. More on the 2026 season on our website.  Register on the organiser's own page
